sources.title: Miyachi, contribution in OWR17/2009
sources.read_scope: Full contribution read: PDF28–31/printed944–947, especially Thm5,Conj7,Remark8,§0.5.
sources.priority_relation: Target broad bridge; §0.5 characteristic-zero assumption belongs to later rational-method subsection. Stronger index condition separately stated.

sources.title: De Visscher–Donkin, On projective and injective polynomial modules
sources.date_version: MathZ251(2005),333–358; manuscript12January2005; repository cover unspecified version
sources.priority_relation: Structural facts are old. Rank2/3 classifications concern a distinct classification, not the Miyachi existential-rank bridge. Conditional Thm5.1 not imported as unconditional.

sources.title: Elkin–Webb, The structure of Young modules and Schur algebras in characteristic2
sources.priority_relation: Wrong characteristic for p3. Same shape(4,1) alone is not a matching predecessor. General augmentation discussion acknowledged.

sources.title: Turek–Wang, Symmetric powers of S^(n−1,1) and D^(n−1,1)
sources.read_scope: Actual§3.1 printed9: natural permutation sequence, Specht simplicity iff p does not divide n; definitions and James1983 citation; intro/main theorems and outline.
sources.priority_relation: Confirms known Young/permutation/Specht ingredient; does not itself supply nonprojectivity at all ranks or explicitly refute Conj7 in inspected content.

sources.title: Doty–Martin, Hook modules for general linear groups
sources.read_scope: Abstract,§1 labels/Schur functor,§2 main theorem/corollaries,§3 block comparison inspected.
sources.priority_relation: Degree p hook block, whereas target degree2p−1. Useful sign/column-regular conventions; not same degree or target bridge.

sources.title: Ming Fang, Projective-injective modules of Temperley–Lieb algebras
sources.priority_relation: DD classification appears as motivation; main results about TL algebras and rank-two dominant dimension. No current worldwide-open inference.

sources.title: Erdmann–Law, Torsion pairs and Ringel duality for Schur algebras
sources.read_scope: Actual§3.1–3.3 printed4–6;Prop3.1 classical analogue;Theorem3.3;§5Lemma5.1 printed17–18; refs10=Erdmann–Henke2002a.
sources.priority_relation: Rank-two exact sequences and projective-injective identification specialize to the local obstruction; no existential-rank Young-top criterion stated in inspected theorems.

sources.title: Koshitani–Sakurai, Reciprocity for projective and injective direct summands
sources.priority_relation: General multiplicity reciprocity under skew-bimodule hypotheses. No Young/Schur specialization or same counterexample given in inspected body. Abstract machinery alone not a full predecessor.

sources.title: Same OWR primary report via institutional TIB
sources.read_scope: Independently retrieved to reproduce original author byte pin. Compared normalized extracted contribution to EMS body.
sources.priority_relation: Different PDF bytes/typography; original body hash matches TIB, not current EMS. Do not silently substitute body pins.

sources.priority_relation: Unread gap; cannot exclude as exact predecessor from snippet.
